This flow chart is a complementary tool to the Imposition of the community and custodial sentences guideline that supports
sentencers to determine the right type of sentence. It should NOT be used without the guideline, as it focuses only on
the questions pertaining to the type of potential sentence and does not include other pertinent guidance, such as the
consideration of the purposes of sentencing, requesting a pre-sentence report, and the effectiveness of sentencing, among
others. Please read the full Imposition of community and custodial sentences guideline before using this flow chart.
